sentences.en: I come to the school every day.
You come in through the door.
She goes out of the house.
We go to work by train.
I keep the money in my bag.
He lets me use his book.
She lets the dog run in the garden.
I send a letter to my friend.
You send a message to her.
We stay at home on Sunday.
They stay in the hotel for a week.
